[*] Fixed an issue that caused the selected trucks in the lobby to reset to the default ones after opening and closing the friends list
[*] Fixed an issue where accepting invitations didn't open the lobby at once if the player's game wasn't running
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the messages sent in the lobby chat to be received with a significant delay

notes.title: Crossplay now available for Steam and the Epic Games Store!
notes.content:
Hello MudRunners!

With this small update, we're excited to introduce crossplay between Steam and the Epic Games Store.

If you’re playing on Steam and want to play MudRunner with players on the Epic Games Store (EGS), you'll need to have an EGS account.
When joining the multiplayer menu, you’ll be asked if you want to enable crossplay. 
If you don’t accept, you can only play with other Steam players that haven’t enabled crossplay.
If you accept, a web page will open in your browser asking you to log in to (or create) an EGS account.

To play MudRunner with friends from the Epic Game Store, you'll need to link your EGS account and Steam account.

[h3]How to find my friends from the Epic Games Store:[/h3]

First, you must link your Steam and Epic Games account. Please follow [url=https://www.epicgames.com/help/en-US/epic-accounts-c74/connect-accounts-c110/how-do-i-add-my-friends-from-my-steam-account-to-my-epic-games-account-a3625]these instructions[/url].

Once you've linked your accounts, a permission box will appear in your internet browser the next time you launch MudRunner on Steam.

Finally, to find your Epic Friends on Steam, you need to allow this permission:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30379632/74d6ca842d0540c7395da4f0d4630eb06c3fa324.png[/img]

Now, after creating a lobby, you will find your EGS friends in the friends list.

This update also fixes an issue with mods on Steam where mods created after June 2020 were not working in multiplayer.

We hope you enjoy playing with your friends across both Steam and the EGS!

In case you encounter major issues with this update, you can revert to the previous build.
To do this, go to your library, right-click on MudRunner > Properties > BETAS > Select “vers_11_05_19”

Roll out, MudRunners!

The Chevrolet Napco 3100 is the little truck that could. Take care of it and it will serve you for life, and maybe your children's, too. Go on and take it out for some rock crawling in the new Rocky Hills map!

notes.title: Community Update - 27/02/19
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jgTnt0H.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

It’s time for a new community update about MudRunner and what we have planned for the future. 

We know that many of you are wondering if MudRunner will see more content added or if the next step is the release of MudRunner 2. [b]We’re happy to confirm that we have a new free DLC planned for MudRunner[/b]. 

We’ll unveil more details about this DLC in the upcoming months but you can expect something similar to the various free DLCs already released for MudRunner, such as The Ridge or The Valley.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KNw7FQi.jpg[/img]

Most of the team is now focused on the development of MudRunner 2. [b]During Focus’ yearly press event “What’s Next”, much more info will be shared about the game[/b]. As some of you noticed, although it was originally scheduled for February, it has been moved to April 10-11. We’re sorry about this but it’s ultimately for the best, as we’ll have a lot more to show in April.

[h1][b]MudRunner Community Survey[/b][/h1]

Today, we’re happy to share this community survey, that we’ve prepared to get your feedback and suggestions about the future of the MudRunner franchise.

Click here to answer the [b][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeqYgs4PU7NAMyiYUEXZjrJNAa2fz1JI3WEtlmrV-rDcXxm-A/viewform]MudRunner Community Survey[/url][/b].
You'll need about 10 minutes to fill out this survey. We'll close it in two weeks.

We want to be completely clear that the [b]purpose is not to get a list of features for MudRunner 2[/b]. The development of MudRunner 2 is going great, and most features have already been locked down. We can’t wait to share more about that with you all!

The purpose of this survey is for us to get to know all of you a little better, [b]for the benefit of the overall MudRunner experience, franchise, and future[/b]. Please do not interpret these questions as indications of what might appear in MudRunner 2.

[b]The survey should take 10 minutes to complete[/b]. These questions have been chosen based on all [b]your feedback since the launch of Mudrunner[/b], be it from the Forums, Discord, Steam, or elsewhere.

Please share this survey with your MudRunner friends. Thanks once again for your passion and dedication to improving the MudRunner experience!

notes.title: MudRunner - October Community Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sOCf9Zd.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

It's the end of October, and with that comes another Community Update, as I'm sure you all have been expecting.

Today also marks a very special day for the MudRunner community! [b]It's been a year since MudRunner released[/b], and we've come a long way since then! [b]We'd like to thank the community for spending so much time in our games, and for helping us make MudRunner the best off-roading game it can be.[/b] 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8KXDXzgjQKM
[b]We'd also like to extend a very special thanks to the MudRunner modders[/b]. You all do incredible work, and we're honoured that you spend so much time creating your own works in MudRunner. We can't wait to see what you do next!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QajXHYk.jpg[/img]

In this past year, not only did MudRunner release, but  we've seen the release of three DLC packs! Join me now while we go through all the cool new things we saw released this year.

Firstly, MudRunner itself - released on October 31st, 2017, bringing the franchise to Xbox One and PS4 for the first time! In the run up to the release, we released vehicle presentations for the most iconic vehicles in the game - all of which can continue to be seen on in our new area specifically made to collect [url=https://forums.focus-home.com/category/244/mudrunner-legacy-vehicle-presentations]previous vehicle presentations[/url]!

After that, [b]we released The Valley, the first of three DLCs[/b], which introduced one large new map to the game, and three new vehicles! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pG7Ky2r.jpg[/img]

Then, [b]in May, we released The Ridge[/b], which introduced not only a new map and two new vehicles, but also [b]a challenging new game mode, Scavenge[/b], which tasked you with recovering lost lumber from around the map, instead of collecting it from lumber mills. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/11mKK5m.jpg[/img]

Then, just [b]this last week, on October 23rd, MudRunner - American Wilds was released[/b], a brand new premium DLC that introduced nine new vehicles to the game, and two new maps! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y2jzQuUPSgo
And that brings us to [b]today, October 31st, exactly one year since MudRunner first released[/b]! We'd like to thank each and every one of you for sticking with us this long, and we hope that the next year is as great for you as this last year was for the community!

Looking forwards, we've got a couple of projects to keep us busy! Most immediately, we've got the [b]Switch version of MudRunner[/b], which brings the game to the portable platform, meaning you can get muddy wherever you are! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wxgwkTc.jpg[/img]

In the further future, we have MudRunner 2, a still in early development project that we're all very excited about here at Focus and Saber.

For now, we're going to focus on the Switch version of the game, and will have more news for you in the future!

notes.title: Vehicle Presentation - Introducing the K-9000 Forwarder!
notes.content:
American Wilds is a new DLC coming to MudRunner Fall, 2018! This large DLC will introduce brand new content to the game, including several new vehicles, two new maps and a whole new location - The United States of America!

Today, we're very excited to be talking to you about the K-9000 Forwarder!
MudRunner - American Wilds releases on October 23rd on PC, PS4 and Xbox One and comes to Nintendo Switch on November 27th!

[b]Vehicle Description:[/b]
A powerful working vehicle, the K-9000 Forwarder is a loader that you can rely on to move not only logs, but vehicles that may get trapped in treacherous terrain.

[b]Game Stats:[/b]
The K-9000 has always on differential lock, as well as all-wheel drive availability.

[b]Strengths:[/b]
Featuring a loading crane and an integrated cart, the Forwarder is more than prepared for log collection, and with its powerful engine and large wheels, is able to do so on any terrain.

[b]Weaknesses:[/b]
The K-9000 is a powerful vehicle, but that power comes at the price of speed and maneuverability. The K-9000 is locked behind balance points.

[b]Attachments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Loader - Allows Scavenge Logs to be collected
[*] Fuel Trailer - Contains 1800 liters of Fuel
[*] Medium Log Trailer - Can carry Medium Logs
[*] Utility Trailer - Contains 600 Repair Points, and 2 Garage Points
[/list]

American Wilds is a new DLC coming to MudRunner Fall, 2018! This large DLC will introduce brand new content to the game, including several new vehicles, two new maps and a whole new location - The United States of America! 

In the run-up to American Wild's release, we're bringing back Vehicle Presentations -  today, we'll be talking about Ford F150!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EcVTgfl.jpg[/img]

[b]Vehicle Description:[/b]

A smaller vehicle, the F150 is equipped with the ability to drive in all-wheel drive and take advantage of differential lock, as well rear-wheel drive when not in all-wheel drive mode. A powerful consumer vehicle, the F150 is a useful four-wheel drive utility vehicle.

[b]Game Stats:[/b]

With a smaller fuel tank than the large trucks, The F150 is a great vehicle for scouting with its 80 litre fuel tank, but relies on closer support vehicles to make longer trips. Able to take 300 points of damage as well, the Ford can more than make its way around the map easily. 

[b]Strengths:[/b]

A speedy, nimble vehicle, Ford F150 is at home on the roads and in the mud. If you need to scout a new path, you can rely on this vehicle to get you where you need to be. 

[b]Weaknesses:[/b]

As with all smaller vehicles, the Ford F150 has a small complement of add-ons, and so won't be doing the majority of the workhorse work for your vehicle fleet. 

[b]Attachments:[/b]
[list]
[*]Bed Cap - Cosmetic
[*]Repair Supplies - Carries 20L of Fuel and 150 Repair Points

[/list]

notes.title: September Community Update - Switch Release Date
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Edn2SYQ.gif[/img]

Hello, and once again welcome to your monthly MudRunner Community Update!

We're getting closer and closer to the release of American Wilds next month on October 23rd on PS4, Xbox One and PC.

[b]We're happy to announce today that MudRunner - American Wilds now has a date for its Nintendo Switch debut: November 27th![/b]

Like the versions on other platforms, the Nintendo Switch version of MudRunner – American Wilds Edition will bring together the new expansion, the base game and all the DLC content released so far, for a total of over 30 vehicles, 60 add-ons, 10 sandbox maps, and 11 challenge maps.

In the lead up to these releases, we've begun showcasing different aspects of the game to you, so that you can see what's coming, and ask us any questions you may have about the content of the game.

Today's community update is going to go into what we've shown since then, and collect it into one place for your easy attention.

[b]Vehicle Presentations[/b]

The first vehicle we showed off was the Hummer H1!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CfPgMPx.png[/img]

[url=https://forums.focus-home.com/topic/30036/%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B7%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F-%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%85%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8-hummer-h1]You can read the full vehicle presentation for it here.[/url]

Secondly, we showed the Chevrolet K5 Blazer!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rv5MMij.png[/img]

[url=https://forums.focus-home.com/topic/30398/%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B7%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F-%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%85%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8-chevrolet-k5-blazer]Read the accompanying vehicle presentation here![/url]

[b]Featurette[/b]

Next, we released a featurette showing one of the new maps coming in American Wilds. You can check it out here, and take a first look at Grizzly Creek!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X4Yl6NcUKOg
[b]Livestream:[/b]

We've also done a live stream, where you can see the other vehicles in the game being driven around one of the new maps. We also answer some community questions, so if you're looking to see those vehicles being driven, [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/315301473?t=1m15s]check it out here on Twitch![/url]

That's all for the MudRunner - American Wilds stuff that we've released up until today's community update. As always, you can expect a new vehicle presentation tomorrow! We'll be showing off a larger vehicle this time.

[b]MudRunner - American Wilds releases on PC, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One October 23rd and on Nintendo Switch on November 27.[/b]

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kWjImFv.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, and welcome to August's community update!

This month has been a busy one for us, with Gamescom 2018 and some very interesting announcements for MudRunner in the future! We're very excited to [url=https://forums.focus-home.com/topic/28154/mudrunner-2-announcement/]have announced MudRunner 2[/url], and you should expect more news about MudRunner 2 at What's Next in February, our yearly event.

Now, on to what you've been waiting for - [b]MudRunner - American Wilds![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xCWUkCW.jpg[/img]

We're very excited to be able to unveil more officially American Wilds, which introduces [b]seven iconic American vehicles, from brands such as Ford, Hummer and Chevrolet![/b] This will take the total of vehicles in American Wilds up to over thirty, with the total game having 60 add-ons, ten sandbox maps and eleven challenge maps at launch too!

In American Wilds, you'll be exploring new terrain in the United States in [b]two maps, Grizzly Creek and Mount Logmore[/b], inspired by the rough environments found in [b]Montana, North Dakota and Minnesota[/b]. You'll overcome muddy terrain, raging rviers and other obstacles with up to three players in multiplayer. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Tohl0lh.jpg[/img]

As with any other DLCs to MudRunner, we'll be doing vehicle presentations, map profiles and showing the addons that you can expect to be included with the vehicles. We look forwards to sharing these with you in the lead up to American Wilds!

[b]MudRunner - American Wilds releases in Fall 2018, on PC, PS4 and Xbox One.[/b]

notes.content:
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/905651930370103195/9D72505155A85B605125D6FD6011794F907A5E77/[/img] 

Hello everybody!

Yes, it's that time again - time for the monthly community update, where we let you know what's going on in MudRunner behind the scenes. 

Firstly, let's start with a thank you! MudRunner has sold over one million copies, and [b]we're incredibly thankful to the community for helping us get to that breathtaking number.[/b] We wouldn't have gotten there without you!

Now, on to the meat and bones of this update.

This month, we'd like to tell you about the MudRunner USA expansion that we've been teasing for a little while.

So, to start - the name. MudRunner USA will actually be called [b]American Wilds[/b], and will be an expansion pack for MudRunner, and will be coming to PS4, Xbox One, PC and Nintendo Switch, at a to-be-announced date this fall.

American Wilds will come with many features that you have been asking for, [b]including two new sandbox maps and licensed vehicles[/b]. We're not ready to announce what those vehicles are at this time, however, but we very much look forwards to introducing them to you!

Pricing wise, American Wilds will be available in two forms - [b]you'll be able to buy it individually as an expansion pack[/b], or as a full package with the original MudRunner, in the [b]MudRunner - American Wilds[/b] edition. There will be more information about the pricing of this closer to release. 

We don't have screenshots to show you of American Wilds at the moment, due to the fact that vehicles are still being worked on. Once we do have them, we'll show them to you here. We thank you for your patience with us on this. 

Many thanks, and we look forwards to showing you more about American Wilds as time goes on!

notes.title: The Ridge Out Now - May Community Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aZ0lvsF.gif[/img]

Hello, and welcome once again to the MudRunner Community Update!

First things first, let's talk about The Ridge! 

[b]The Ridge is the latest DLC coming to MudRunner, and is totally free and out now on PC, PS4 and Xbox One![/b] 

[b]In The Ridge, you will discover a brand new map, two new vehicles, and Scavenge game mode[/b]. This new game mode, unique to The Ridge (but able to be implemented by modders in their own maps) tasks players with needing to track down and recover logs from random "scavenge locations" around the map. These locations are randomly selected each time you start the map, and are spawns of single logs that must be recovered using a crane attachment!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/11mKK5m.jpg[/img]

The Ridge also introduces two new vehicles, [url=https://forums.focus-home.com/topic/6687/mudrunner-introducing-the-d-538]the D-538[/url] and [url=https://forums.focus-home.com/topic/6662/vehicle-presentation-introducing-the-b-6a]the B-6A[/url], which you can learn about in their vehicle presentations, here! The new DLC also introduces new vehicle add-ons with which to take on The Ridge's treacherous hills. 

The Ridge Changelog:

[h1][b]Changelog:[/b] [/h1]

[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*] New gameplay mode - Scavenge
[*] New map - The Ridge
[*] New vehicles - B-6A and B-538
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Locked trucks are now covered in cloth
[*] Wheel physics have been improved (wheels are now softer)
[*] Anchors and cranes are now more powerful and move more smoothly
[*] Automatic gearboxes have now been improved
[*] Mod-related stability improvements (crashes due to memory limitations have been fixed)
[*] The in-game mod browser now displays information about the mods
[*] Various other fixes
[*]  Added the ability to disable tips about shortcut keys
[/list]
[b]You may want to continue playing on the older version of MudRunner, so that your mods stay compatible.  you use find the public branch ver_18_03_06 in your betas.[/b]

To access this, right-click MudRunner, click properties, and then betas. In the drop-down menu, select "ver_18_03_06". This will give you the ability to play on the previous version of MudRunner. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hY5D2Ev.jpg[/img]

[h1] [b]Community Update:[/b][/h1]

Now, onto what is coming in the future!

We're now continuing to work more fully on what is coming out in the next releases - which would be MudRunner USA and MudRunner Switch (both working titles). As such, it means that we won't have much new information to give in the next couple of months about what we're working on with MudRunner, aside from just repeating the same announcements each week.

As we move to working more fully on these two releases, we don't want the community updates to just say the same thing over and over - so [b]the plan for future updates will be to showcase cool things from the community[/b]! To do this, we will begin [b]showing off the best maps that we find, cool vehicle mods, and other interesting creative works made by you[/b]! Should you see anything, or make anything, that you're proud of, please send us a link to it, we'd love to see it too!

Thank you, and as always, we'll talk to you soon!

notes.title: April Community Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/905651930370103195/9D72505155A85B605125D6FD6011794F907A5E77/[/img]

Hello all!

It's time for another one of those regular Community Updates!

This time around, we're actually going to start off talking about something a little more immediate, and making an announcement!

[b]We're happy to announce The Ridge, the second free DLC for MudRunner![/b]

In The Ridge DLC, we'll be introducing a brand new map, two new vehicles, and, for the first time, a brand-new gameplay mode. 

On The Ridge, you will find a towering mountain ridge that divides the map into two areas, and that is incredibly difficult to cross. This will be made trickier with the introduction of the [b]two new vehicles, the D-538 and the B-6A[/b]. We will have more details on these vehicles in the future in individual vehicle profiles, but both vehicles will also introduce new add-ons to the game as well! 

These new add-ons will help players tackle the [b]difficult new game mode being introduced to The Ridge, Scavenge.[/b] 

Scavenge mode, unique to The Ridge, is a mode where there are no log stations. This means that you won't be able to just collect logs and transport them. Instead, there are now random "scavenge locations". These locations are two or three locations that are randomly selected each time you start the map, and that [b]spawn static logs which must be collected with a crane![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/11mKK5m.jpg[/img]

We don't currently have a specific planned release date for The Ridge, but we currently plan for a release date at the end of May. We will continue to add screenshots to this post as we have them to share with you. 

As has become the norm for these community updates, I'll also let you know what the team are currently working on, and what to expect in the future. 

We continue to work on MudRunner USA, and will have more information on this in the future, but we are currently looking into our options towards licensed vehicles for this. 

We are hugely grateful to the dedicated and passionate modding community for helping us make MudRunner the best game it can be, but, for now, we're only exploring what options we have, no concrete plans to implement mods on consoles in the short run.

Lastly, the Nintendo Switch version of MudRunner is still in development, but we don't have much more to say about this currently. 

Thank you, all, and we'll talk to you soon!

notes.title: Workshop Map Support Introduced
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30379632/5e8de5075e080825c63a31d44413726e408d2446.jpg[/img]

Hello all,

Today, we're very happy to release an update that adds Workshop Map Support to Spintires: MudRunner on PC. What this means for you is that we now officially support map mods in Spintires: MudRunner, and players will be able to upload and download their creations through the Steam Workshop, in the same way that they can for trucks. 

[b]You will find an update to both Spintires: MudRunner and the Spintires: MudRunner Editor.[/b] 

[b]Should you need help learning how modding tools work in Spintires: MudRunner, [url=http://cdn.focus-home.com/admin/games/spintires_mudrunner/docs/ModdingGuide_Mudrunner.pdf]here is our official guide.[/url][/b] This will teach you to make both map mods and vehicle mods. 

Some community members have also done very useful guides, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/675010/guides/?browsefilter=trend&requiredtags%5B%5D=Modding%20or%20Configuration&requiredtags%5B%5D=English#scrollTop=0]which can be found here.[/url]

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Multiple bug fixes and improvements to level editing mode.
[*] Undo/redo history now works for changing object position and orientation.
[*] Trucks are now better visualised on the map. Truck/trailer/addon picker dialog added.
[*] Truck orientation can now be arbitrary. (Trucks are no longer required to be landed.)
[*] Mods can now contain levels that are properly exported to the workshop.
[*] Improvements were made to the "import spintires-2016 level" function.
[*] Truck textures are now better optimised when exporting to the workshop.
[*] Added "default screenshot for the item" function added for mods.
[/list]

[b]If you want to play older maps on this new version, you will need to convert them to the game using the conversion tool in the edtior. Once this is done, the older maps will be compatible with Spintires: MudRunner[/b]

Should you not want to move to this new update just yet, you are able to stay on the current branch by going to "public branch ver_18_01_29b" in your available betas. 

Thank you, and we'll talk to you soon,

The Spintires: MudRunner team.

[b]If you want to play older maps on this new version, you will need to convert them to the game using the conversion tool in the edtior. Once this is done, the older maps will be compatible with MudRunner[/b]

Should you not want to move to this new update just yet, you are able to stay on the current branch by going to "public branch ver_18_01_29b" in your available betas.

The MudRunner team.

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30379632/860cc9febe940babf6ea8f87eef19f00633f68a5.jpg[/img]

Hello all!

As was stated in the last update post where we announced The Valley, we're going to be doing a monthly community update for Spintires: MudRunner, to let you know what we're working on, what to expect soon, and some other cool things!

To start, it's not been that long since The Valley released on February 13th, but we're very happy to see so many players enjoying the map and the three new vehicles that we added to the game at this time. What has been your favourite part of The Valley so far?

We have a little treat for you all today, in addition to all the news below. We've noticed that some players have been making their own navigation maps and that these have been made using screenshots of the fully explored map screen, or in some cases hand drawn. We understand that this is something that many of you would like to do, and so we've **packaged all the map images, in high resolution, for you to print off and make navigation maps** with. Please enjoy!

The maps can be found here: [url=https://we.tl/IYVl6j93B6]Downloadable Maps[/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30379632/a456372fb7c041ca1e3be255f2bd3af5d4247564.jpg[/img]

Now, the bit that you've all been waiting for, [b]what we're working on[/b]! There's actually a lot going on with Spintires: MudRunner right now, all of it in various stages of development, and not much of it that we can actively talk about at the moment. With that said, we can specifically say some things that we're working on and aim to have out this year.

We're currently working on an additional update coming out early this year that we currently expect to include [b]workshop map support[/b], as well as some other cool new features! 

As well as this, yes, [b]MudRunner USA (work-in-progress title) is currently in development[/b], and we aim to have this out this year. It will, of course, be set in the United States. We understand that a large part of the Spintires: MudRunner community are based in the United States, and would like to support them with content that is a little bit more familiar. We're also looking into licensing official vehicles for this.  

In addition to MudRunner USA, we're continuing to explore the options of [b]adding mods to the console versions[/b] of the game. We love the modding communities for Spintires: MudRunner, and thank them for their enthusiasm in continuing to help us make Spintires: MudRunner the best game it can be.  We continue to currently look into the possibility to add some of our favourite mods into the console versions of Spintires: MudRunner as DLC.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30379632/fa4ddb3b028d3d0052de46efbe2eb97d36dc65e3.jpg[/img]

Finally, a [b]Nintendo Switch version[/b] of Spintires: MudRunner is currently being worked on. We don't have much more to say about this right now, but it is coming, and we'll have more news about it in the future!

In conclusion, we're working on a lot of different things currently, all of which will come later in the year! We'll have more news on these individually as the year progresses.

Thanks, and talk to you soon!

notes.title: Announcing Free DLC - The Valley!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30379632/a456372fb7c041ca1e3be255f2bd3af5d4247564.jpg[/img]

Hello all!

It's now been just over two months since Spintires: MudRunner launched, and it's our absolute pleasure to announce the first DLC for Spintires: MudRunner, The Valley.

We currently plan for this first DLC to release in February. It will be a [b]free[/b] content update. This first DLC will include brand new content for the game, in many different forms. Firstly, it will introduce a brand new map, also called The Valley, which is a very large heavily forested map. Similar to Deluge in the base game, you will start outside of a garage, and will need to claim one for yourself.

In addition to a brand new map, we will also be introducing three new powerful vehicles. These three vehicles can be used on any map, provided you have enough progression points unlocked. Like for other maps and their specific vehicles, you won't have to spend points to use these vehicles in The Valley.

There will be the [b]A-969[/b], a powerful 4x4 vehicle, specially adapted to the heavily forested terrain of The Valley.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30379632/5e8de5075e080825c63a31d44413726e408d2446.jpg[/img]

The [b]C-6317[/b], a six-wheeled truck able to sport a wide arrangement of add-ons.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30379632/3cf371f6633f0a163ca75eae35795c8a297776f8.jpg[/img]

And the [b]E-7429[/b], a very large 8x8 truck with a special hidden talent. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30379632/2754badbd702890ece4408d8f05487b625ae274a.jpg[/img]

We'll have more information on each of these vehicles in the lead up to release, in weekly vehicle presentations and factsheets once again.

Not only will there be new vehicles and a new map in The Valley, but there will also be eight new addons.

These are as follows:
[list]
[*]C-6317 Spare Wheel
[*]A-969 Spare Wheel
[*]A-969 Fuel Canisters
[*]A-969 Garage Parts
[*]A-969 Utility Attachment
[*]E-7429 Advanced Trailer Hitch
[*]E-7429 Repair Kit
[*]E-7429 Garage Semi-Trailer (Also compatible with the E-7310 from the base game)
[*]Medium log trailer (compatible with some trucks from the base game)
[/list]
For the modders out there, there will be some more assets for you to play with when making your maps and vehicles!

These are:
[list]
[*]E-7310 trailer hitch
[*]A broken tree asset, which is currently only used on the The Valley
[*]A dirt road terrain overlay type, which is also currently only used on The Valley
[/list]

Players will be able to muck around in The Valley as soon as the DLC is installed, so if you've just got the game, and not finished other maps, don't worry! You can get stuck into The Valley all the same.

Your goals on The Valley will be similar to classic maps, unlocking other garages and lumber mills around the map.

We look forward to sharing you more about the DLC as time goes on!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30379632/09640a498ec86b9811f210405cd27527947193e9.jpg[/img]

That's not all, though! In addition to this new DLC news, we'd like to say that we plan on doing a [b]monthly community update[/b] for you all, sharing what we're working on, and introducing some cool things that we've seen from the community.

Talk to you soon!

notes.title: Second Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/875251999083434657/435ED75A22B74CDD5B040E959B3448796D0D394E/?interpolation=lanczos-none&output-format=jpeg&output-quality=95&fit=inside%7C*%3A0[/img]

Hi everyone,

It's been just over a month since Spintires: MudRunner launched, and we're happy to announce that the second Spintires: MudRunner update is now out!

Here are the main additions and fixes. 

[h1][b]CAMERA[/b][/h1]
[b]Centered Camera[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new camera centered on vehicles, that is now used by default by all players.
[*]Players can choose the legacy camera by disabling "Center camera on the truck" in the settings
[*]The new centered camera can be zoomed in/out to increase visibility.
[*]While using Quick Winch, the legacy camera will be used, if players are using a controller.
[/list]
[b]Cockpit Camera[/b]
[list]
[*]New feature: Look out of the left window while reversing. 
[*]Cockpit camera can no longer be activated underwater.
[*]Cockpit camera can now zoom in.
[*]Cockpit camera is now activated with the right mouse-button.
[*]Added a keybind to activate cockpit camera.
[/list]

[h1][b]MODS[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]In multiplayer, if the host had multiple mods installed, and then created a lobby and selected only modded trucks, the client was unable to join and the game would crash. This has now been fixed.
[*]"Reload" in The Proving Grounds will now reload the addons attachment position.
[*]Long mod names will now be shortened.
[/list]

[h1][b]SAVING & LOADING[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Plants (trees) are now properly saved to and loaded from save files.
[*]When moving the camera, the map is now loaded more efficiently. 
[*]The game now autosaves every 5 minutes
[/list]

[h1][b]TUTORIAL & CHALLENGES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The front/rear camera hint is now presented at the beginning of the tutorial, and in THE RIG challenge, and will no longer appear in REPAIR & REFUEL.
[*]THE RIG cockpit bonus objective will now correctly mark itself "finished" as soon as the player reaches the unloading area.
[*]The tutorial will now demonstrate both the legacy and centered camera versions.
[/list]

[h1][b]OTHERS[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed the requirement to align a trailer to the truck when loading logs onto a trailer.
[*]Multiplayer chat will no longer overlap with keyboard/gamepad hints at the bottom of the screen.
[*]The mouse will now work properly after activating the Steam Overlay with a gamepad or steering wheel.
[*]When clicking on "load up" points to pack a load, advanced mode will no longer be exited.
[*]Various other tweaks and fixes.
[/list]

In upcoming patches, we plan to include Workshop support for maps, working mirrors in cockpit view, and additional wheel support. 

We'll give you more visibility on updates as soon as we can. Please continue to give us your feedback so that we can together continue to make Spintires: MudRunner the best game it can be.

Many thanks!

Focus Home Interactive and Saber Interactive

[*]New keyboard shortcuts so that players can easily switch to the cockpit view.
